description: This file defines the LayoutSwitchAnimationListener class, which manages animations for switching layouts in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It handles different animation types such as in-place switch, swipe left, and swipe right, and coordinates animation loading, unloading, and execution tied to keyboard layout changes.

classes.name: LayoutSwitchAnimationListener
classes.description: Handles layout switch animations, including loading, executing, and unloading animations based on user interactions and animation type.

classes.name: AnimationType
classes.description: Enumeration of different animation styles for layout switching: InPlaceSwitch, SwipeLeft, SwipeRight.

classes.name: InputViewProvider
classes.description: Interface to provide the input view that animations are applied to.

classes.name: OnKeyAction
classes.description: Interface to handle key actions triggered after animations.

methods.name: loadAnimations
methods.description: Loads animation resources and sets animation listeners.

methods.name: unloadAnimations
methods.description: Clears animation references to free resources.

methods.name: doSwitchAnimation
methods.description: Initiates the switch animation based on the specified type and target key code.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback invoked when an animation ends; triggers the next animation or key action.

methods.name: getStartAnimation
methods.description: Returns the appropriate start animation for the given animation type.

methods.name: getEndAnimation
methods.description: Returns the appropriate end animation for the given animation type.

methods.name: isKeyCodeCanUseAnimation
methods.description: Determines if a key code supports animation effects.

methods.name: setAnimations
methods.description: Enables or disables animations, loading or unloading resources accordingly.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the object is destroyed.
